name: Just Replay
tagline: Gentle exercise sessions for people with limited mobility, with pose tracking against a guiding avatar.
problem: Grandparents with limited mobility struggle to stay active, the team says.
solution: An intake on age and mobility creates a safe session; pose tracking compares the user's joints with a pre-recorded trainer and an AI coach guides by text and voice.
demo_moment: Team-described: follow the avatar while the app scores the match.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH: Best Use of Vultr” among 307 submissions.
Adapts intensity to a stated mobility limit.

lessons: Start from a named user's limits, not from the exercise.
